title: Signed integer density of an integer multiplicity current supported in an n-plane
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, V ⊆ ℝ^P open, τ = (τ_1, …, τ_n) an orthonormal family in ℝ^P, Q := span{τ_1, …, τ_n}, and S ∈ 𝒟_n(V) an integer multiplicity current (IsIntegerMultiplicity S) with spt S ⊆ Q. Then there is g : ℝ^P → ℝ such that, with H^n = μHE[n] and |g(x)| read as the extended norm ‖g x‖ₑ ∈ [0, ∞]: (i) g is a.e.-strongly measurable for H^n⌞Q; (ii) g(x) ∈ ℤ for H^n⌞Q-a.e. x; (iii) ∫_{K∩Q} |g| dH^n < ∞ (lower Lebesgue integral) for every compact K ⊆ V; (iv) S(ω) = ∫_{V∩Q} g(x)·ω(x)(τ_1, …, τ_n) dH^n(x) (Bochner integral) for every ω ∈ 𝒟^n(V); (v) M_W(S) = S.massOn W = ∫_{W∩Q} |g| dH^n for every open W ⊆ V.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (V : Set (Euclid P)) (S : GeometricCurrentOn V n) (τ : Fin n → Euclid P), IsOpen V → Orthonormal ℝ τ → IsIntegerMultiplicity S → S.support ⊆ (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range τ) : Set (Euclid P)) → ∃ g : Euclid P → ℝ, AEStronglyMeasurable g (μHE[n].restrict (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range τ) : Set (Euclid P))) ∧ (∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range τ) : Set (Euclid P))), ∃ m : ℤ, g x = m) ∧ (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ V → ∫⁻ x in K ∩ (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range τ) : Set (Euclid P)), ‖g x‖ₑ ∂μHE[n] ≠ ∞) ∧ (∀ ω : TestFormOn V n, S ω = ∫ x in V ∩ (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range τ) : Set (Euclid P)), g x * (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x τ ∂μHE[n]) ∧ ∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → W ⊆ V → S.massOn W = ∫⁻ x in W ∩ (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range τ) : Set (Euclid P)), ‖g x‖ₑ ∂μHE[n]
